parts.name: Handle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle portion of the USB flash drive, typically made of durable plastic and located at the rear end for easy attachment to keychains or lanyards.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a convenient way to hold, pull, or attach the USB drive to other objects, ensuring portability and ease of use.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move relative to the main body.

parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the protective cap of the USB flash drive, made of plastic, designed to cover and protect the USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: It shields the USB connector from dust, moisture, and physical damage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It is detachable and can be removed or reattached to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, housing the internal memory chip and USB connector, typically made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components responsible for data storage and transfer, and provides the main structure for the device.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part that holds the internal components and connects to the computer via the USB connector.
